description: This is a CLI script for the 'universalinit' project, which provides command-line support for initializing various project templates. The script handles argument parsing, template creation, configuration parsing, and output formatting for project setup. It interacts with components like 'TemplateInitInfo', 'ProjectConfig', and 'ProjectInitializer', and supports fetching project-specific run commands.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate types (bool, int, float, str).

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object for retrieving template info, used mainly for getting the run command.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base directory.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Serializes a TemplateInitInfo instance into a dictionary suitable for JSON output, converting paths to absolute paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints a standard JSON response indicating success/failure, message, and template configuration.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs a JSON object containing the project type and its associated run command.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the --get-run-command argument, retrieving the command for running the project based on the minimal configuration.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point of the script that handles argument parsing, command execution, and project initialization.

ctags.name: output_json
ctags.pattern: /^def output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_pat/
ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
